verdict.rationale: Cal.com documents event-triggered webhooks with a trigger enum (BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_PAID, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED, BOOKING_CANCELLED, etc.) and a customizable payload template sent to a subscriber URL. It also lists native 'workflows' as a platform capability, and a Zapier app automates actions when bookings are created, rescheduled or cancelled, or when a meeting ends. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the native workflow rule builder (conditions and action types), evidence of conditional rule logic beyond event subscription, independent or hands-on corroboration.
